text: Jantii -an Nulaaɗo-, tuma nde haɗaynoɗaa jamaa jeyanooɗo e maɓɓe gaayi e pankarere, na reentinabe duum, jamaa goo wi'ani ɓen : "Ko honɗum waajantoɗon yimɓe, Allaahu ko halkoowo ɓe aduna ko ɓe faggitori kon geddi, maa O letoya ɓe Ñalnde Darngal lepte sattuɗe?" Waajotooɓe ɓen wi'i : "Ko men waajoranta ɓe, ko ittangol Alla nganto ko O yamiri men yamirgol moƴƴere haɗa ŋiñere hara O nanngitiraali men tertagol ɗum, e belajo'o, ɓe nafitora waaju ngun, ɓe ɓooroo e geddi".
